modules.name: My lil Arpeggio
modules.description: Dual quantizer and arpeggiator sharing one scale: 10 presets, an editable keyboard, and a scale-degree interval for in-key harmony

modules.name: My lil Ripple
modules.description: Polyrhythm trigger generator with an ADSR envelope: four period generators mixed on a grid or as summed waves into two complementary rhythms, with accent and clock outs, and an envelope out fired by the rhythm

modules.name: My lil Filter
modules.description: Acid 24 dB resonant low-pass for audio: drive, cutoff CV with amount, 1 V/oct key tracking, resonance CV, polyphonic

modules.name: My lil Slider
modules.description: Two 8-step slider sequencers with gate buttons: record CV and gates live, per-section length, range, invert and reverse, chain to 16 steps
